annotation.evidence_span: MAY either assume a media type of "application/octet-stream" or examine the data to determine its type.
annotation.interpretation_a: The recipient is permitted to always assume 'application/octet-stream' regardless of the data.
annotation.interpretation_b: The recipient is permitted to always examine the data to determine its type, bypassing the default.
annotation.justification: The use of 'either...or' with 'MAY' grants complete discretion to the recipient. There is no guidance on when to default to 'application/octet-stream' and when to inspect the data. This allows for materially different implementations.
annotation.missing_information: The clause does not specify any criteria for *when* the recipient should choose one behavior over the other. A missing constraint on the selection criteria creates ambiguity.
